question: Should Crabpot advance the ClawRouter fixture to an upstream commit that adds direct Polymarket betting capability, after refreshing the fixture reports and expectations?
rationale: The patch imports a material external-plugin capability change rather than only a neutral version marker, and repository policy requires fixture evidence that the current one-line update does not provide.

options.title: Review, recreate, and validate the update
options.body: Have Dependabot recreate the bump from current main, add the generated fixture report/test expectation changes, pass the isolated check, and approve the imported capability before merge.

options.title: Hold the fixture at its approved pin
options.body: Close or defer this update if Crabpot should not currently exercise the added direct-betting capability.

recommendation.title: Review, recreate, and validate the update
recommendation.body: Have Dependabot recreate the bump from current main, add the generated fixture report/test expectation changes, pass the isolated check, and approve the imported capability before merge.
